addition.item: First public release: a site module that builds a table of contents from the headings of the article currently being viewed, entirely in the browser, with no external JavaScript or CSS dependencies.
Heading levels picked up are configurable (H2 to H6), and the module hides itself completely when the article contains fewer matching headings than the configured minimum.
Three placements independent of the assigned module position: at the top of the article, floating left of it, or floating right of it.
Optional numbered list, collapsible box (optionally collapsed on load), and smooth scrolling with a configurable scroll offset for sticky site headers.
Appearance settings for width, background, border, text and link colours, font size and a custom wrapper class, plus a per-instance Custom CSS field.

Adjustable article content CSS selector, with automatic detection of the article body when the selector matches nothing — this is what makes the module work on page builder layouts such as YOOtheme Pro, which emit no recognisable article markup.

Module chrome is recognised for templates that wrap modules in a card, a moduletable or a "module-<id>" element, so the whole box is moved next to the article; wrappers the moved or hidden module leaves empty are removed with it.
Ships English (en-GB) and Ukrainian (uk-UA) language files, and supports alternative module layouts.

security.item: The Custom CSS parameter is stored unfiltered by design but is sanitised on every render before it is echoed: selector break-outs, braces, comments, at-rules and the legacy script-in-CSS vectors are stripped, so an operator with edit rights on the module cannot inject markup or script into the page.

note.item: Requires Joomla 6.0 or later and PHP 8.3 or later.
